dm_single:
سلام! مرسی که کامنت گذاشتی 😊

5 پرامپت آماده‌ی برنامه‌ریزی سفر 👇
جاهای خالی رو پر کن:

1. برنامه:
"Plan a ___-day trip to ___ for ___ people, budget ___. We like ___. Group nearby places on the same day, with morning, afternoon and evening plans."
2. بودجه:
"Turn this plan into a budget table: stay, food, transport, tickets, plus 10% emergency money. Mark prices as estimates."
3. وسایل:
"Make a packing checklist for ___ in ___ (month), based on usual weather and our plan."
4. روز بارونی:
"Give me an indoor backup plan for each day."
5. چک نهایی:
"Check this plan for problems: too much travel time, places that may be closed, and what I must confirm on official websites."

قیمت، ساعت کاری و قوانین ویزا رو همیشه از سایت رسمی چک کن.
راهنمای پرامپت‌نویسی: platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/overview
